prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Edit Image 1, the camp smithy concept, to implement the following corrections. Image 2 is the PRIMARY material and painterly rendering reference, the newly approved merchant stall. Image 3 is ONLY the shape/style reference for the requested hanging lantern. Image 4 shows the real in-game merchant stall; use it only to understand the broad material treatment and overhead readability, never reproduce the camp or its lighting/UI.

1. REMOVE the entire freestanding foreground anvil AND its wooden stump/base completely. Leave no freestanding objects in front of the workshop. Instead put ONE simpler squat anvil ON THE REAR LEFT part of the wooden workbench, within the workshop's footprint, behind its front edge and clearly visible beneath the shallow canopy.
2. SIMPLIFY substantially: eliminate the mechanical bench vise, the little rear tool container with its many tools, the right-side box with dangling implements, fine rope wraps, tiny individual stitch marks, cloth repair patch, extra steel pieces and most decorative fasteners. Keep only the integrated large anvil, ONE chunky hammer, ONE plain broad sabre blank along the rear shelf, and TWO broad iron ingots on the lower shelf. Leave most of the worktop empty. Keep the one basic leather bellows, without its small mechanical fittings. Stone forge and chimney made from FEWER, LARGER block shapes, no dense masonry lines or tiny chips. Each timber joint has at most one simple broad iron plate and one large rivet, no rivet clusters. Broad clean cloth folds, a simple cream hem and restrained ochre seam binding, no little patch or stitches.
3. MATCH MATERIALS TO IMAGE 2 closely: the SAME warm honey-brown wood palette, SAME broad painted grain strokes and low texture density, SAME large matte bevels, SAME dull dark iron with soft simple colour planes. Do not add realistic bark, fine cracks, shiny polished metal, yellow specular outlines, glossy varnish or photographic textures. Reduce material contrast in image 1, especially the bright fine stone bevel outlines. Stone uses large calm warm grey/taupe colour planes consistent with this hand-painted prop family. Entire result should feel painted by the same artist as the merchant stall, not a more detailed or realistic render. Keep the canvas TERRACOTTA with warm CREAM edging and a restrained OCHRE accent taken from Eni's clothes. No olive/green canvas.
4. Add exactly ONE compact hanging lantern on a short thick iron hook outside the LEFT upper timber arch, clear against transparent space and away from the worktop. Use the simple lantern family of image 3, but WITHOUT its long rope across the image. Small square dull dark iron lantern, chunky frame, amber warm glass, about 30–35 cm high. Two broad iron rings for hanging; no delicate chain. No visible flame, light bloom or external glow; the lamp is a neutral physical game prop with warm coloured glass.

Preserve the major workshop layout: wooden bench to the left, shallow rear canvas awning on two timber arches, stone forge and chimney on the right outside the cloth roof footprint. The awning remains short and covers only the rear part; exposed worktop reads clearly from above. Same overhead orthographic three-quarter view, about 48 degrees elevation.
One complete workshop ONLY in a SQUARE 1:1 transparent PNG. Scale the whole subject to fit with a clear 8% transparent margin, no cropping, all feet and chimney top visible. TRUE transparent alpha background, preserve transparency. Neutral diffuse material shading.
No people, flags, heraldry, writing, symbols, grass, landscape, ground plane, paving, overall plinth, cast shadow, fire, smoke, glowing forge, sparks or dramatic scene lighting.
changes: Убраны отдельная наковальня спереди и её пень. Простая наковальня расположена на дальней левой части верстака.
Убраны тиски, многочисленные инструменты/коробки, часть слитков, мелкие крепления, верёвки и строчки. Каменные блоки укрупнены.
Материалы ориентированы на концепт новой лавки; точное совпадение игровых 3D материалов требует общей настройки после конвертации.
Добавлен один подвесной фонарь с тёплым стеклом на левой дуге.
Сохранены терракотовые, кремовые и охристые цвета Эни и открытая поверхность верстака.
